symptom: User reported an empty phone scene after opening the first packed-ab preview

reproduction.finding: SDK reused StreamingAssets build_info/version metadata across exports sharing the same AppID and relative paths. Changing DATA_CDN host/port alone did not isolate this cache.

fix.server: Only the configured build prefix aliases the current StreamingAssets directory; other build prefixes return 404

verification.phoneAfterFix: Android fetched build-scoped manifest/bundles at 12:18 and uploaded six complete CPU benchmark runs by 12:19:48

note: A cleanup-before-start experiment was tested only in DevTools, triggered SDK stale data-file paths, and was rolled back before phone preview. Final fix does not delete caches. No new phone CPU benchmark or standard Profiler frames are claimed.
